source.title: Remark on: New directions and open problems in iteration theory by Gy. Targoński

trace.notes: Normalized the single input URL https://zbmath.org/1728015 as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver with trailing identifier 1728015. Local workflow resolver metadata identifies the exact source title as "Remark on: New directions and open problems in iteration theory by Gy. Targoński" and year 1991. This metadata was used only for exact-work identification and title recovery, not for technical extraction.

Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches to zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org; metadata_only for the zbMATH resolver/search surfaces and the ResearchGate author/publication listing; missing readable artifact for the exact work. Browser/page-reader access to the zbMATH URL and API/OAI entry points did not expose a readable primary source body containing technical problem statements.

Ran bounded exact-work recovery using the zbMATH identifier 1728015, the exact recovered title, the exact title plus author names Jarczyk and Targonski, and the related title "New directions and open problems in iteration theory". Inspected candidates were rejected because they were metadata-only ResearchGate or zbMATH listings, the separate EuDML record for "Almost iterable functions" rather than the exact source, later papers or reports merely citing Targonski's 1984 report, or snippets/reference lists without the 1991 source text. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source was recovered.
